items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: For instance, like Miles Davis used to tell guys, you don’t play like with the front part of your foot.

ctx.x: And is it something you can actually tell a bass player.

No. You can’t. It’s where he hears the time. The one thing that I do on most occasions — the thing that bothers me the most is okay you get to the gig and you see the bass player there and the hatchback’s opening up and the first thing I see that comes out of the hatchback is the stool. I say that’s a stand-up bass. Stand on your two feet and play it man, you know because you’re anchored. For instance, like Miles Davis used to tell guys, you don’t play like with the front part of your foot. I mean that’s not…
